line: Told her, “Take a step back,” I don’t deal with no regrets
vault_lines: Told her, "Take a step back," I don't deal with no regrets
meaning:
In this lyric, Che makes it clear that he’s not interested in being too friendly with any women, mostly because he knows that it will come with some regrets down the line.

This lyric also serves as a callback to Ski Mask the Slump God’s 2017 album, YOUWILLREGRET, and one of Ski’s most popular songs of all time, Take a Step Back.

line: Hit the road, Jack, and don’t you come back No more, no more, no more, no more Hit the road, Jack, and don’t you come back no more What you say?
vault_lines: Hit the road, Jack, and don't you come back
meaning: The beat utilized throughout the track samples the 1961 song Hit the Road Jack by American singer and musician Ray Charles.
